descriptions.__sfp: SN newlib __sfp: finds a free FILE (chaining the static 10-FILE glue block on first use), resets it and gives it a preallocated buffer or the unbuffered byte.
descriptions.__smakebuf: SN newlib __smakebuf: marks regular seekable files for fseek optimization (blksize 1024), others not, and always makes the stream unbuffered.
